chunks: 2499 - Al-Sakuni narrated with his chain of transmission; he said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"Beware of resting upon the middle of the road and in the bottoms of the valleys, for they are the pathways of wild beasts and the shelter of snakes."

key_terms.التَّعْرِيسَ: resting or halting for sleep during travel
key_terms.بُطُونِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ: the low inner parts or beds of valleys
key_terms.ظَهْرِ الطَّرِيقِ: the middle or exposed surface of the road
key_terms.مَأْوَى الْحَيَّاتِ: the shelter or dwelling place of snakes

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about resting on roads and in valley beds?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers not to stop or rest in the middle of roads or in valley beds. It teaches practical caution and proper conduct in travel, noting that such places are routes for wild animals and dwelling places for snakes. The narration reflects the Prophetic sunnah (prophetic tradition) of combining safety, etiquette, and awareness of harm.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2499 - Al-Sakuni narrated with his chain of transmission that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) said:
"Beware of resting along the middle of roads and in the valleys, for they are pathways for wild beasts and shelters for snakes."
